title: Auwal Mosque
geometryBasis: The exact named Dorp Street footprint supplies the facade length, three shallow projections and full prayer hall envelope. The cleared 2024 photo supplies the stepped olive facade, minaret profile, white cornices and entrance ironwork.
sectionBasis: The gate and minaret heights are estimated in proportion to the cleared street photograph. Native elevation supplies the approximate sidewalk grade, with exposed foundation adapting to the local slope.
limitations: The model depicts the gray-green frontage and minaret photographed in December 2024. Heights, rear details and the corners outside the cropped view are estimates.
The original elevation field is preserved. The architectural platform and sidewalk registration use approximate contact.
Interiors, freestanding palms, signage lettering and neighboring structures are outside the model scope.
